messages:
Eli Park: Hi all  first day here (Eli, AE). Quick setup question: I don't see HubSpot/Gong in my app list and I can't access the AE playbooks on Drive. Who should I bug for seats and the canonical onboarding doc?

Ops IT: Welcome Eli! Please create a ticket with the quick-provision form or paste this snippet into the portal:
```
product: Sales tools
requester: Eli Park
email: eli.park@redwood.example
access: HubSpot (full), Gong (seat), Drive Playbooks
priority: standard
needed-by: 2024-07-10
```
I'll watch for the ticket and ping when invites go out.

Eli Park: Ticket submitted as REQ-5234. Thanks!

Sam (enablement): Hey Eli  landing page for AE Onboarding is /Sales/Playbooks/AE-Onboarding-2024. Start with "Intro to Discovery" and "Deal Qualification checklist". I can walk you through the call tags later. DM me for the calendar invite.

Priya (CS): Also FYI, for handoffs we use the "CS Handoff" template in Drive (Sales/Playbooks/Templates). If you want a sandbox lead to practice logging activities and handoffs, tell me and Ill spin one up.

Eli Park: Thanks Sam and Priya. REQ-5234 status is "in progress". Any idea ETA?

Ops IT: Should be resolved today unless SSO mapping needs manual adjustment. Will update ticket with invite links once finished.

onboard-bot: Welcome Eli Park! Onboarding checklist created: /onboarding/eli_park_1742654321. Tasks added: Accept HubSpot invite, Gong onboarding video, Shadow session x2, CRM logging practice.

Sam (enablement): Quick tips for Gong: enable auto-tagging rules (Settings -> Call Tags) and check the "AE - discovery" cadence in the Gong folder. Also watch the 12-min "Gong for AE" recording in Playbooks.

Ops IT: Ticket updated: REQ-5234 -> HubSpot seat granted, Gong invite sent. Please accept invites and sign in via SSO. If you hit a 403, reply here with a screenshot.

Eli Park: Got HubSpot and Gong invites, logged in successfully. Can someone point me to the short objection-handling one-pager?

Priya (CS): objections_quickref.pdf in Playbooks -> Objections. I'll share a copy to your Drive. Also happy to do a 20-min run-through after your first shadow.

Sam (enablement): Added you to the "AE Onboarding - Week1" calendar. Friday 11:00-12:30 is shadow + debrief. Well record so you can replay.

Eli Park: Amazing, thank you all  excited to dive in :rocket:

Ops IT: All good for now. Re-open the ticket if anything else breaks.

Priya (CS): Welcome aboard Eli! :tada:
